name: Omaigent
author: Omaigent
description: Gemini chat panel for the Omarchy shell, powered directly by the Gemini API. Paste a Gemini API key once and converse with Gemini from a native panel summoned with SUPER+G or from the menu. Replies stream as they are generated.

barWidget.description: Omaigent — chat with Gemini using the Gemini API. Opens the chat panel; left click toggles.
